neutral_facts.correct_value: The accused was charge-sheeted with offences relating to an incident that occurred on 12/13 April 2008. The accused later surrendered. The judgment does not describe the circumstances of the alleged assault, the identity of the victim, or the manner of any death. The material before the court concerned the accused's age on the date of occurrence. A school leaving certificate issued on 10 April 2004 by the then principal of a primary school recorded the accused's date of birth as 10 May 1991. The head mistress identified and recognised the principal's signature and gave evidence to that effect. An investigating officer's report indicated that the accused and another person with a similar name were different persons. A medical board opined that the accused was about 20 years old on the date of occurrence.
